# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The log for a browser: http://BOARD:8081/log.csv?k=PIN, polled from the GUI's timer. The PIN on
# the screen keeps a passer-by out, no more (plain HTTP).

import socket


class FileServer:
    def __init__(self, port, pin, content, name):
        self.port = port
        self.pin = pin
        self._content = content  # function: the file's text
        self._name = name        # function: the file's name
        self._socket = None
        self.served = 0

    def start(self):
        listener = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        listener.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, 2, 1)  # SO_REUSEADDR
        listener.bind(socket.getaddrinfo("0.0.0.0", self.port)[0][-1])
        listener.listen(2)
        listener.setblocking(False)
        self._socket = listener

    def poll(self):
        if self._socket is None:
            return
        try:
            client, address = self._socket.accept()
        except OSError:
            return
        try:
            client.settimeout(0.5)
            request = client.recv(1024).decode()
            target = request.split(" ", 2)[1] if request.count(" ") >= 2 else "/"
            if target == "/log.csv?k=" + self.pin:
                body = self._content().encode()
                head = "HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/csv\r\nContent-Disposition: attachment; " \
                       "filename=\"%s\"\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" % (
                           self._name(), len(body))
                self.served += 1
            else:
                body = b"The log is at /log.csv?k=PIN, the PIN on the board's screen.\n"
                head = "HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n" \
                       "Connection: close\r\n\r\n" % len(body)
            client.write(head.encode() + body)
        except OSError:
            pass
        finally:
            client.close()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Data Logger: samples at the pace of a Cortex-M4 timer, a CSV file with the date and time from the
# network, a chart of the last 120 samples, the file for a browser.

import os
import time

import lvgl as lv

from fileserver import FileServer
from sensors import HARDWARE, sensors
from storage import log

EVERY = [1, 10, 60]
POINTS = 120
PORT = 8081

_ui = None
_every = 1
_running = True
_series = []
_server = None


def _font(size):
    return getattr(lv, "font_montserrat_%d" % size)


def _style_matrix(matrix, accent):
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.TRANSP, 0)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    matrix.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    matrix.set_style_pad_gap(6, 0)
    items = lv.PART.ITEMS
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, items)
    matrix.set_style_radius(8, items)
    matrix.set_style_border_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_shadow_width(0, items)
    matrix.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xFFFFFF), items)
    matrix.set_style_text_font(_font(16), items)
    matrix.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(accent), items | lv.STATE.CHECKED)
    matrix.set_button_ctrl_all(lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKABLE)
    matrix.set_one_checked(True)


def _file_info():
    _ui.file_info.set_text("%s\n%d rows, %.1f kB" % (log.path, log.rows, log.size / 1024))


def _address():
    try:
        import mpy_wifi

        ip = mpy_wifi.status().get("ip")
    except (ImportError, OSError):
        ip = None
    return ip or "192.168.7.1"


def tick():
    # Every 50 ms: the samples the timer queued, the browsers, the clock.
    sensors.poll()
    if _server:
        _server.poll()
    queue = sensors.queue
    while queue:
        sample = queue.pop(0)
        t, cpu, a0, vref = sample
        try:
            log.add(sample)
        except OSError as error:
            _ui.now.set_text("Cannot write the file: %s" % error)
            continue
        _ui.history.set_next_value(_series[0], int(cpu))
        _ui.history.set_next_value(_series[1], int(a0 * 1000))
        _ui.now.set_text("CPU %.1f C (Linux)    A0 %.3f V    reference %.4f V (Cortex-M4)\nlast sample %02d:%02d:%02d"
                         % (cpu, a0, vref, t[3], t[4], t[5]))
        _file_info()
    t = time.localtime()
    _ui.clock.set_text("%04d-%02d-%02d  %02d:%02d:%02d  board clock (NTP)" % t[:6])


def every_changed(matrix):
    global _every
    index = matrix.get_selected_button()
    if 0 <= index < len(EVERY):
        _every = EVERY[index]
        if _running:
            sensors.start(_every)
        _ui.legend.set_text(_legend())


def _legend():
    return "orange: CPU 20-80 C (left)   green: A0 0-2.5 V (right)   one every %d s" % _every


def run_clicked():
    global _running
    _running = not _running
    if _running:
        sensors.start(_every)
    else:
        sensors.stop()
    _ui.run_button.get_child(0).set_text("Stop" if _running else "Start")
    _ui.run_button.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0xE0742F if _running else 0x2E9E6A), 0)


def new_clicked():
    log.new(time.localtime())
    _file_info()


def start(ui):
    global _ui, _server
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    chart = ui.history
    series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    while series:
        chart.remove_series(series)
        series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    chart.set_point_count(POINTS)
    chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 20, 80)
    chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.SECONDARY_Y, 0, 2500)
    chart.set_style_size(0, 0, lv.PART.INDICATOR)
    chart.set_style_line_width(2, lv.PART.ITEMS)
    chart.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    chart.set_style_line_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), lv.PART.MAIN)
    _series.append(chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(0xE0742F), lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y))
    _series.append(chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(0x4CC38A), lv.chart.AXIS.SECONDARY_Y))
    _style_matrix(ui.every_buttons, 0x2F6FDE)
    ui.every_buttons.set_button_ctrl(0, lv.buttonmatrix.CTRL.CHECKED)
    ui.legend.set_text(_legend())
    log.new(time.localtime())
    _file_info()
    pin = "%04d" % (int.from_bytes(os.urandom(2), "little") % 10000)
    if HARDWARE:
        _server = FileServer(PORT, pin, log.read, lambda: log.path.split("/")[-1])
        try:
            _server.start()
            ui.download.set_text("http://%s:%d/\nlog.csv?k=%s\n\nPIN %s" % (_address(), PORT, pin, pin))
        except OSError as error:
            ui.download.set_text("No server: %s" % error)
    else:
        ui.download.set_text("Simulator: the rows\nstay in memory.")
    sensors.start(_every)
